# `aitbc market offer`

List a hardware and software bundle offer in the market.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc market offer [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--service-type` | choice | — | yes | The Service type. |
| `--model-or-variant` | text | — | yes | The Model or variant. |
| `--price` | decimal | — | yes | The Price. |
| `--unit` | choice | `per_1k_tokens` | no | Pricing unit |
| `--description` | text | — | no | Description of the service |
| `--context-window` | integer | `4096` | no | Context window size (ollama) |
| `--gpu-name` | text | — | no | GPU name from nvidia-smi (auto-detected if omitted) |
| `--gpu-device` | text | — | no | GPU device ID (0, 1, 2, etc.) for multi-GPU servers |
| `--gpu-offer-id` | text | — | no | GPU market offer ID for cross-reference |
| `--disk-quota-mb` | integer | — | no | Per-customer disk quota in MB (default 100 for IPFS, unset for GPU services) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc market offer --service-type <service_type> --model-or-variant <model_or_variant> --price <price>
```
